config.meshcore.additional_prompt_help: Optional guidance for MeshCore replies and use of the MeshCore tool, such as language or reply style. Up to 2000 characters. Permissions, security rules and radio limits still apply.
config.meshcore.search_nodes: Search nodes by name or key
config.meshcore.chat_nodes_only: Only chat nodes can be selected
config.meshcore.direct_replies_help: The trust list only stores the contact. This switch starts the agent and allows the radio reply.
config.meshcore.remove_channel_confirm: Remove channel {name} from the connected MeshCore device? Its saved agent permissions will also be removed.
config.meshcore.save_first: Save changes before running this action.
config.meshcore.failed: Request failed. Check saved settings and runtime status.
config.section.meshcore.desc: Connects one MeshCore companion radio over USB or native Linux Bluetooth.
config.meshcore.security: Channel replies use public knowledge and optionally Brave search only. Trusted direct messages retain existing AuraGo permissions. Failed security checks quarantine input.
config.meshcore.keys_help: One complete 64-character public key per line. Names and channel senders never establish trust.
config.meshcore.channels_help: Confirm each channel assignment before enabling replies or proactive sending. A changed device or channel blocks automatic work until reassigned.
config.meshcore.ble_help: Linux BlueZ only, unavailable in Docker. Enable Bluetooth and allow pairing changes in Bluetooth settings. Audio permission is unnecessary. PINs are used only for pairing and never saved.
config.section.meshcore.label: MeshCore
config.meshcore.allow_location_disclosur: Allow the agent to disclose a location
config.meshcore.disclosed_location_help: Only this text may be disclosed. Device positions, coordinates, routes, and inferred locations remain private.
config.meshcore.inbox_help: Shows the latest 100 messages, 25 per page.
config.meshcore.enabled_help: Turns on the MeshCore radio link. Without it AuraGo does not process mesh messages.
config.meshcore.transport_help: How the MeshCore device is attached to the server: by USB cable or over Bluetooth (Linux only).
config.meshcore.port_help: Serial port of the connected device. "Refresh" looks for new devices.
config.meshcore.address_help: Bluetooth address of the MeshCore device, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Only needed for Bluetooth.
config.meshcore.pin_help: Used for pairing only. The PIN is not stored.
config.meshcore.search_nodes_help: Filters the node list below by name or public key.
config.meshcore.add_to_help: List a node is added to when you use the button in the node list.
config.meshcore.allow_location_disclosur: The agent may share the location text entered below on the mesh. The text is readable by every recipient.
config.meshcore.proactive_send_help: The agent may send messages to the send nodes on its own, without having been contacted first.
config.meshcore.max_command_age_seconds_: Commands older than this are ignored (600-86400 seconds, default 600). Protects against replayed messages.
config.meshcore.future_tolerance_seconds: How far in the future a message timestamp may lie (120-3600 seconds, default 120). Compensates clock drift.
config.meshcore.retention_days_help: Received messages are deleted after this time (7-90 days, default 7).
config.meshcore.max_messages_help: Maximum number of stored messages (1000-10000, default 1000). Older ones are dropped first.
config.meshcore.peer_runs_per_minute_hel: How often the agent may react per node or channel and minute (2-60, default 2). Limits spam from single senders.
config.meshcore.runs_per_minute_help: How often the agent may react to mesh messages per minute in total (12-120, default 12).
